grade.description: The bare grade number, "3", or "" when the set names none

credit.description: The attribution line the product must show for the set's questions

ids.description: Every question the set holds, in set order

ready_ids.description: By language code: the questions that are lesson-ready in it, in set order

question_types.description: The question types of the set's lesson-ready questions, in any language (dl-n9fr.70)
The question types of its lesson-ready questions

problem_types.description: The set's problem types, each with the question types it holds

ready_types.description: By language code: how many lesson-ready questions of each question type

description: One question set's public page: its titles, skills and credit, the ids of its questions, which are lesson-ready per language and their question types; never a question's body

QuestionSetId.description: A question set's id, such as set_khan_x24e08583ca4994d1: set_ then letters, digits, _ and -

BankQuestionId.description: A bank question's id: a Khan item id such as x1a2b3c4 or an Alfik task id such as alfik_2024_k2_q07, letters, digits, _ and - only
